$comment: Brumista's protocol: every command it answers. The source of truth: the C++ dispatch table in src/BrumistaCommands.cpp is checked against it (tools/check-commands.sh), and the MCP server will generate its tools from it. Shapes use the notation of protocol/limen/commands.json: JSON values as type names, a key ending in ? may be absent, [T] is an array of T. limenDiff notes where a command departs from limen's.

transport.framing: one JSON object per line, newline-terminated, both ways; empty lines are ignored, a trailing \r is dropped
transport.clients: one at a time; a second connection waits for the first to close

the command's params, at the top level

ok.result: the command's result; null for commands that return nothing

transport.threads: commands marked main touch the engine or the scene: they are queued and run in Brumista's widget step(), on the main thread. The server thread waits 2 s. A command still queued when the wait ends is cancelled and never runs; one the main thread has started is waited for until it finishes. Commands marked server read plugin data that doesn't change while Rack runs.
limenDiff: Every read that touches the engine or the scene runs on the main thread; limen reads params, ports, cables and module info from the server thread.
A timed-out command is cancelled rather than left queued (limen problem late-timeout).
A request line over 1 MiB closes the connection with "request too long".

commands.name: hello
commands.description: Brumista's version and the commands it supports. The version is the plugin's, which the protocol and the MCP binary share.
limenDiff: limen replies { protocol: 2, commands }; Brumista names itself and reports its semver version instead of an integer.

commands.name: list_models
commands.description: Every module model Rack can create, optionally for one plugin.

plugin.description: plugin slug; an unknown slug returns an empty list

commands.name: list_modules
commands.description: The modules in the patch, with grid position and width.

plugin.description: plugin slug; an unknown slug returns an empty list

commands.name: get_module
commands.description: One module, in the shape list_modules uses.
commands.result: same object as one list_modules entry

commands.name: get_module_info
commands.description: What Rack's right-click Info menu shows: model metadata, tags and the plugin's identity and links.

commands.name: list_ports
commands.description: A module's inputs and outputs by index, with their names.

inputs.name: string, empty when the port has no name

outputs.name: string, empty when the port has no name

notes: Lists every port the engine module declares, including any with no jack on the panel.

commands.name: list_params
commands.description: A module's parameters: current value, name, range and unit.

commands.name: get_param
commands.description: One parameter, in the shape list_params uses.
commands.result: same object as one list_params entry

commands.name: list_cables
commands.description: The cables in the patch with their colours, optionally only those touching one module.

id.description: only cables with this module at either end

result.color?: string, "#rrggbb" or "#rrggbbaa", from the cable's widget

limenDiff: Adds color, which limen doesn't report.
